name: base_utils
description: Manages common host utilities and baseline presentation configuration, including optional MOTD management and installation of Hiera-provided utility packages. It also provides supporting custom types, functions, facts, plans, and task material.

name: profile_app_stack
description: Deploys a Python application end to end by managing the application user and directory, Git checkout, virtual environment, dependencies, protected environment configuration, database migrations, systemd service, and supporting monitoring, logging, and database components.

name: profile_haproxy
description: Configures an HAProxy load balancer with packages, generated frontend and backend configuration, custom error pages, optional service discovery, firewall rules, TLS, statistics, and production stick tables.

name: profile_postgresql
description: Manages PostgreSQL repository setup, package installation, version selection, and service management with distribution-aware configuration for supported operating systems.

name: profile_redis_cluster
description: Configures a Redis service with listener binding, password protection, memory limits, LRU eviction, AOF persistence, and frequent fsync. It also supports discovery of cluster nodes through a custom PuppetDB query and fact.
